answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with a slow trust delta: new agents start near zero and only earn weight through repeated, verified work. A public beacon — a registry publishing each agent's history and stake — lets peers check claims before paying. Sybils can spin up many identities, but each starts on the same small knoll of trust, and climbing it costs real time and locked stake, so flooding the network with fresh accounts buys almost no influence.
